title.zh: Pagehaven · 页间 — 纯静态漫画阅读器与台词搜索工具
title.en: Pagehaven · Static Manga Reader with Client-Side Dialogue Search

summary.zh: 纯静态部署的漫画书库与阅读器，支持单页、双页和长条阅读模式，并用 SQLite Wasm 在浏览器端直接搜索台词定位页码。
summary.en: Static manga library and reader supporting single-page, double-page, and vertical scroll modes, using client-side SQLite Wasm to search dialogue and jump to pages.

zh: 在浏览器端通过 SQLite Wasm + HTTP Range 按需读取索引分块，输入台词即可跳转到对应章节和页码
支持单页、双页、长条滚动切换，带本地书架状态、页码书签备注以及 JSON 进度导入导出
通过一份 site.config.yaml 配置文件即可构建部署到 GitHub Pages 或 Cloudflare Workers 等静态托管平台
en: Client-side SQLite Wasm with HTTP Range requests for searching dialogue without a backend server
Single, double, and vertical-scroll reading modes with local bookmarks and JSON progress backup/restore
Single site.config.yaml configuration targeting GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and other static hosts

milestone.zh: 静态构建、SQLite Wasm 台词检索与三套配色主题均已可用。
milestone.en: Static builds, SQLite Wasm dialogue search, and color themes are complete.
